actions.subject: Certificate of origin and HTS: HR-13103 and HR-40220
actions.body:
Dear Priya Raman,

We are confirming the country of origin for parts you supply, as the origin decides the duty that applies on entry. Our records do not hold it.

- Ball screw assembly, 12x4 mm (HR-13103)
- Actuator, electric linear (HR-40220), open on HPO-26-00442/10 and HPO-26-00656/20

For each part, please send the country of origin (where it is made, not where it ships from) and the HTS classification you use, with proof such as a certificate of origin.

Please reply by 15 October.

Best regards,
Dana Reyes
Halden Robotics

actions.subject: New dates on HPO-26-00623 and revised dates for HPO-26-00554 lines 30 and 40
actions.body:
Dear Zhou Hui,

Thank you for your notice of 24 September about the cyberattack and the schedule change. Could you please confirm that the new dates on HPO-26-00623 lines 10, 20 and 30 still hold now that your systems are being restored, and that the first shipment on 9 October is on schedule? For HPO-26-00554 lines 30 and 40, which are past due and have no new date in your mail, please give us a revised promise date for each and tell us what will ship.

Three of these five lines were already past due on 25 September (marked below).

HPO-26-00623/10 · Harness, lidar power and ethernet (HR-21107) · 890 EA · promised 28 September, now 30 October
HPO-26-00623/20 · Harness, main distribution (HR-21111) · 115 EA · promised 24 September, now 20 November (past due)
HPO-26-00623/30 · Harness, fork actuator and sensors (HR-21112) · 270 EA · promised 28 September, now 30 October
HPO-26-00554/30 · Harness, drive motor power and hall (HR-21109) · promised 24 September, no new date (past due)
HPO-26-00554/40 · Harness, battery 48 V (HR-21110) · promised 21 September, no new date (past due)

Please reply as soon as you can, and by 9 October.

Also: Please also send the country of origin (where it is made, not where it ships from) and the HTS classification you use for the Harness, tote lift motor and limit switches (HR-21106), with proof such as a certificate of origin. Please reply by 15 October.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
Halden Robotics

actions.subject: Revised promise dates and allocation after your 18 September notice
actions.body:
Dear Lin Yu-ting,

Thank you for your notice of 18 September. It moves five of our open PO lines to new dates. Two of these lines are already past due (marked below).

HPO-26-00486/10 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 24 V (HR-51110) · 555 EA · promised 21 September, now 9 November (past due)
HPO-26-00517/20 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 5 V (HR-51130) · 810 EA · promised 23 September, now 4 November (past due)
HPO-26-00517/10 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 12 V (HR-51120) · 630 EA · promised 30 September, now 11 November
HPO-26-00672/10 · DC-DC converter, 48 V to 24 V (HR-51110) · 445 EA · promised 20 November, now 8 January
HPO-26-00646/10 · Power supply, AC-DC (HR-51310) · 85 EA · promised 23 November, now 4 January

Please help us with the following:

1. Please confirm a revised promise date for each of the five lines above.
2. Can any of these lines ship earlier than the new dates, in whole or in part? Please give the quantity and date for each.
3. Can you allocate quantity to Halden from capacity that is not covered by the notice, and on which lines and dates?
4. Please confirm the lead-time change in your notice from 8 weeks to 16 weeks for orders placed after 1 October.

Please reply by 1 October.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
Halden Robotics
